reference.constraints: Match native source cut frames, typography, poster composition, Launch Film pane geometry and preview order, provider medallions, MORRO transition and camera-like app tile. Artwork is independently-authored SVG/CSS; no pixel-identity claim without original editable source layers/fonts. V19 specifically reproduces the source timing at frames 496-516 and the eight discrete Star History labels at 523-530; the cube uses a reduced turn angle to expose multiple faces. The camera tile must transition from layered MORRO geometry into an illustrated rounded camera cube with a front portrait face, black glyph/arrow side, blue clock/artwork face, lime EASE face and cream editorial face; end lockup must preserve a legible domain capsule. Countdown 1 must be the same blue extruded prism in Preview and the enlarged Preview takeover; avoid changing it to a flat white numeral. Keep the near-full-frame black panel rounded and preserve the source's orange/blue orbital rings and blue corner wedge. The Launch Film preview zoom is not a generic scale: preserve the 780 source window geometry and reproduce frame-specific Preview card bounds at frames 885/889/890/891. Comic 1962 split panels must use a narrow 20% side rail on each side, with central pop-art radial scene, yellow/red target and yellow CLICK burst. The 1965 Infinity dots poster uses a dense irregular white dot field and yellow D-shaped app badge with black speckles. MORRO transitions from oversized repeating solid/outline type into a rounded typographic tile, blue/cream letterfield and violet folded ribbon, then glossy app icon. V30 source-specific corrections: the opening uses painterly watercolor clouds with a low horizon; the 1965 infinity mark is circular; the 1973 optics shot must show a rainbow spectrum splitting from the orb; the 1985 pixel-game shot contains a gold oval portal and white cursor; the MIND poster has a translucent faceted polyhedron; the eye poster is an angular blue-grid iris on black with 3.7% bottom-right; the camera cube shows the clock only on the top at frame990, a black glyph on the camera-facing side, yellow 100K at frame1005, and the black app face at frame1020. Final brand lockup should be materially larger. V31 MORRO frame905 is a full-contrast centred cream tile approximately 1,120px square, not a translucent small card over the repeating typography. By frame915 it contracts to approximately 720px and transitions into a blue/cream letter tile crossed by broad purple folded bands. At cube frame990 the blue/gold clock must be visibly presented on the top plane while the black glyph remains camera-facing; do not substitute the clock for the front face. The 100K face uses dense green halftone and large bold 100K lettering. For camera cube: the clock belongs on the top plane at source frame990 and must be transferred to the adjacent side at source frame1005. The green EASE lower fold remains below the camera-facing black mark; never put the full EASE face on top. The opening sky must read as painterly clouds with irregular organic clusters, varied soft/wet edges, pastel blue/cream/pink haze and low distant blue horizon, not a repeated scalloped band or clean horizontal gradient rows. The MOTION word has tight but non-colliding letter spacing.
